SELECT a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
       ((ar."HIST_sign"
         + (ar.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric
         + (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
        * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status
                  WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
                  WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                  WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
                  WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score,
       cm.budget_alloc AS budget_allocation,
       cm.budget_stat AS budget_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ar."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
JOIN "ConservationAndMaintenance" cm ON cm.monitor_link = l.env_link
WHERE a."DYNASTY" IS NOT NULL

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id,
       a.art_title AS artifact_name,
       e.erf AS erf_score,
       COALESCE(e.high_sensitivities, '{}'::jsonb) AS high_sensitivities
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "SensitivityData" sd ON sd."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT (SELECT avg(CASE v.value #>> '{}' WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') v) AS erf,
         (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(v.key, v.value)
            FROM jsonb_each(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') v
           WHERE v.value #>> '{}' = 'High') AS high_sensitivities
) e
WHERE e.erf > 4
ORDER BY e.erf DESC

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id,
       a.art_title AS title,
       r.risk_level,
       ar."HIST_sign" AS historical_significance,
       (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric AS cultural_score
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ar."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "RiskAssessments" r ON r.art_concern = a."ARTregID"
WHERE r.risk_level IN ('High','Medium')
  AND ar."HIST_sign" > 8
  AND (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric > 20

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS registration_id,
       s.erf
       + (l.lux * CASE sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'
                    WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END
          * l."visLxh") / 1000.0
       + 2 * ((a."ageYears" * s.erf * power(e."RH" - 50, 2) * e."TEMPc") / 100000.0) AS tetl
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "SensitivityData" sd ON sd."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT (SELECT avg(CASE v.value #>> '{}' WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') v) AS erf
) s
JOIN "RiskAssessments" r ON r.art_concern = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
WHERE r.risk_level = 'Medium'
ORDER BY tetl DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH cpi AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id,
         a.art_title AS title,
         a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
         ((ar."HIST_sign"
           + (ar.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric
           + (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status
                    WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                    WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
                    WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
  JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ar."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  WHERE a."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming','Qing')
)
SELECT artifact_id, title, dynasty, cpi_score,
       CASE WHEN cpi_score > 7 THEN 'High Priority'
            WHEN cpi_score > 4 THEN 'Medium Priority'
            ELSE 'Low Priority' END AS priority_level
FROM cpi
ORDER BY cpi_score DESC

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id,
       a.art_title AS artifact_name,
       e."TEMPc" AS temperature_celsius,
       e."RH" AS relative_humidity,
       COALESCE(s.high_count, 0) AS high_sensitivity_count,
       CASE WHEN (a."ageYears" * s.erf * power(e."RH" - 50, 2) * e."TEMPc") / 100000.0 > 5
             AND COALESCE(s.high_count, 0) >= 2
            THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
LEFT JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
LEFT JOIN "SensitivityData" sd ON sd."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT (SELECT avg(CASE v.value #>> '{}' WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') v) AS erf,
         (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_each(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') v
           WHERE v.value #>> '{}' = 'High') AS high_count
) s ON true
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"

SELECT DISTINCT e.case_link AS showcase_id
FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e
WHERE e."tempVar24" > 1 OR e."RHvar" > 3
ORDER BY showcase_id

SELECT DISTINCT s."caseID" AS showcase_id
FROM "Showcases" s
LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = s."caseID"
WHERE (10 - ((e."tempVar24"
              + (e."RHvar" / 5.0)
              + (s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric) / 3)) < 5
   OR ((CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'seal_state' = 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3)
ORDER BY showcase_id
